Verified live /v1/models count, alias /v1/messages routing, node tests, Python/JSON/shell checks, helper dry run, diff check, and secret scan.

Verified current 9-model OMLX mapping uses distinct Claude version aliases for repeated tiers. Validated live helper dry run, node bridge tests, Python unittest, compile, JSON, diff, and secret scan.

Fixed by routing Claude-family image requests to configured vision model before normal alias routing; verified local profile retry root cause was OMLX 409 load failure for Qwen3.6 VL-grafted alias and validated Qwen3-VL through bridge.
Added JSON-configurable 15s idle heartbeat guard for slow OMLX streams, updated docs/config, and validated with regression tests.
Added disabled gateway Anthropic/OpenAI provider templates, local ignored config placeholders, setup docs, and validated JSON plus bridge sync/health without committing secrets.
Enabled gateway locally using ignored JSON config and the key file, verified both Anthropic and OpenAI-compatible routes through the bridge, and confirmed health without tracking the secret.

Fixed Local Claude model picker coverage: added gateway aliases to the local profile, made provider model discovery timeout configurable, increased local discovery timeout, and verified the bridge exposes 140 models with 47 Claude aliases including 39 gateway aliases.

Updated the local Claude profile aliases so every visible model label starts with its source provider and the description preserves the exact upstream model ID; verified 47 aliases in the profile and 140 models from the live bridge.

Added automatic Claude Desktop alias generation for discovered conversation models, provider-prefixed labels/source metadata in /v1/models, live-profile generation that keeps only Claude-compatible aliases, and verified the Local profile now has 88 aliases across OMLX, gateway Anthropic, and gateway OpenAI.

Root cause found: gateway aliases were advertised as tool-capable, so tool requests stayed on qwen3.7-max and produced literal tool_call text. Added provider-level toolCapable override, disabled structured tool support for local gateway providers, validated fallback to OMLX tool model returns real tool_use.

Implemented opt-in text tool-call normalization. Routes can set toolFormat: text; the bridge validates <tool_call> JSON against declared request tools and emits Anthropic tool_use blocks. Verified live gateway qwen3.7-max streaming-only route converts a forced text tool call to stop_reason=tool_use.

Updated active Local Claude profile to use endUserAttribution and removed deprecated enduserAttribution. Updated generator and example spec to emit endUserAttribution while accepting old input spelling for compatibility; validated generated config and active profile.

Hardened text tool-call parsing for gateway/Claude Local: supports <function=Tool>{...}</function>, validates required input schema fields before emitting tool_use, consumes empty/incomplete tags like <function=Read></function>, added bridge self-test, and live-validated empty Read tag is swallowed while valid Read tag becomes tool_use.
